feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: CNN left off Air Force One for Trump's upcoming trip, White House signals in new media restriction
entry.summary: The White House has signaled that CNN will be left off Air Force One for President Donald Trump's Saturday trip in the latest media restriction in an ongoing dispute with First Amendment implications.

entry.title: Supreme Court blocks Trump-backed Missouri congressional map
entry.summary: The ruling is a defeat for Republicans seeking to give their party an edge in the midterms for control of the House. It means voters will face a different map than the one used in the primaries.

entry.title: The Pacific is churning with hurricanes. The Atlantic is quiet. Blame El Niño
entry.summary: The Pacific Ocean has had an unusual number of storms this year, while the Atlantic hasn't recorded a single full-blown hurricane. Scientists point to an exceptionally strong El Niño.

entry.title: Takeaways from the Trump-Xi state visit: Pageantry and pandas
entry.summary: The visit comes at an important time for both men.

entry.title: Woman who accused Jay-Z of sexual assault says her claims were false
entry.summary: On Thursday, the woman identified as Jane Doe filed a declaration in Manhattan federal court stating that all of her original claims against the rapper were false.

entry.title: There's a global pandemic treaty that's signed -- and in 'limbo.' What's the holdup?
entry.summary: The treaty aims to help the countries of the world prepare for — and defeat — any future pandemic. Why hasn't it gone into effect?

entry.title: The Supreme Court revives a controversial data system for citizenship checks
entry.summary: The Supreme Court is allowing use of a data system that Trump officials overhauled. The system has erroneously flagged U.S. citizens and a lower court found it violated federal privacy protections.

entry.title: Pope Leo warns a 'paradise of machines' could undermine humanity on his France visit
entry.summary: Pope Leo XIV raised existential concerns about scientific progress, life and human rights during a speech on his first papal visit to France.

entry.title: Hurricane Nolo, a zig-zagging storm, threatens Hawaii with flooding rains
entry.summary: Nolo will slow down as it nears Hawaii's Big Island and is expected to become a major hurricane this weekend, bringing torrential rain to areas that have been flooded by big storms this summer.

entry.title: Trump and Xi strike cordial tone at summit. And, Netanyahu gives defiant UNGA speech
entry.summary: Trump and Xi's U.S. summit continues after a state dinner Thursday night. And, Netanyahu returns to Israel after giving a defensive and defiant speech at the U.N. General Assembly.
